protocol_content.title: Early aortic valve replacement for asymptomatic severe aortic stenosis
protocol_content.research_question: Among adults aged 18 years or older with asymptomatic severe aortic stenosis, compare early aortic valve replacement with conservative management for the efficacy outcomes defined in the Review methods.
protocol_content.review_criteria: Include prospective randomized controlled trials of adults aged 18 years or older with asymptomatic severe aortic stenosis that compare early surgical or transcatheter aortic valve replacement with conservative management and report an eligible Review outcome. Extract endpoint definitions, participant event counts and arm denominators at the longest eligible follow-up available by the Review cutoff.

result_targets.population: Adults aged 18 years or older with asymptomatic severe aortic stenosis enrolled in prospective randomized controlled trials.
result_targets.outcome_definition: Composite of all-cause mortality, hospitalization for cardiovascular causes, stroke, and myocardial infarction, as defined in the Review methods.
result_targets.timepoint: Longest eligible follow-up available by the Review cutoff.
result_targets.analysis_population: Randomized intervention and control groups reported for the selected outcome.
result_targets.selection_rule: Select the longest eligible follow-up without using effect magnitude or direction. Retain only a directly reported participant-level count matching the Review-defined composite; do not substitute a differently defined trial primary endpoint or sum component event counts.

result_targets.selection_rule: Select the longest eligible follow-up without using effect magnitude or direction, then use directly reported participant event counts and arm denominators while preserving the reported endpoint definition.
